name: Shinshitsu no Closet no Naka ni Kakurete Mita! NTR
original_name: 寝室のクローゼットの中に隠れてみた!NTR
source:
Upon finding something strange in the master bedroom that I share with my wife,
I am filled with feelings of suspicion. I secretly hide a recorder in the room and...

End up hiding in the closet, to catch her wet handed.........

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ209458.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在与妻子共用的主卧里发现异样后，
我心生疑虑，偷偷在房间里藏了录音机，然后……

最后索性躲进衣柜，打算将她捉奸在床……
